defects.quote: FACT-02's 95% property is the parallel-analysis threshold by construction, and is checked on simulated noise in tests.
defects.evidence: FACT-02 requires "0 are kept in at least 95% of 100 simulated trials". AD-12 keeps eigenvalue i when it beats "the 95th percentile of the i-th eigenvalue over 100 column-permuted copies". On pure noise the observed top eigenvalue is exchangeable with the permuted ones, so it beats their 95th percentile about 5% of the time. Testing each i separately pushes the false-keep rate above that. A per-trial success rate of ≈ 95% or less gives ≥ 95 successes out of 100 only about half the time (Binomial(100, 0.95)), so the FACT-02 test is flaky, not true by construction.
defects.fix: In AD-12, change the rule to a sequential parallel analysis at a stricter quantile: "keep eigenvalues in order while each exceeds the 99th percentile of the i-th eigenvalue over 200 column-permuted copies; stop at the first that doesn't". Replace the Consequences sentence with "the per-trial false-keep rate is ≈ 1%, so FACT-02's ≥ 95-of-100 bar fails by chance with negligible probability". Change `lab.fit_factors` `trials: int = 100` in lab/contract.md to match.

defects.quote: The window's 756 sessions hold equal counts of 8 and 12
defects.evidence: The first test period starts at session 757 (TC-28) and `engine.Window` puts a gap of max(5, horizon) sessions between `train_end` and `period.start`. So the first period's training window can hold at most 757 − 1 − gap sessions (≤ 751), not 756. engine/contract.md `training_window` (length 756) doesn't say what happens when that much history doesn't exist. With 751 sessions, 1..751 holds 376 eights and 375 twelves, so the mean is 9.9973, not 10, and fails TC-60's 1e-9 tolerance. TC-68 relies on the same claim ("any 756-session window (28 whole periods) has correlation exactly I"), but a 751- or 735-session window isn't whole Fourier periods, so its correlation isn't exactly I.
defects.fix: engine/contract.md `engine.training_window`: add the invariant "a rolling window is clipped to coverage start when fewer than `length` sessions precede `train_end`". TC-60: put the test period later (e.g. use `session_calendar(n)` with the test period whose rolling window holds a full 756 sessions, or set `length` explicitly to an even count that fits) and state the window's session range explicitly. TC-68: choose a window length that is a multiple of 27 inside the available history (e.g. `length=729`) and state it.
